clientSeedGenerator.format: <phase-family prefix><32 lowercase hex chars = 128 random bits>

meta.decisionGenerator: node:crypto randomInt (plan drawn up front and stored in meta.plan; in-round choices drawn at play time and stored on the round)

/hilo2/fairness.derivation: block_i = HMAC_SHA256(key = serverSeed, message = clientSeed:nonce:i); the stream is block_0 ‖ block_1 ‖ … read 4 bytes at a time as big-endian u32s. A u32 of 4294967248 or more (2^32 − 2^32 mod 52) is skipped; otherwise the card is u32 mod 52. One nonce per round: the k-th card turned after the start card (by a guess or a skip) is stream card k − 1. The start card is not from the stream — it is the card you see when you bet (it carries over from your last round, or a free skip before the bet drew it), and any start card is worth the same.
/hilo2/fairness.cards: Card id 0–51: suit = id / 13 (0 ♠, 1 ♥, 2 ♦, 3 ♣), rank = id mod 13 (0 = A lowest … 12 = K highest). The deck is infinite: every card is drawn independently, 1 in 13 for each rank.
rules: on each card you guess the top button (hi) or the bottom one (lo), or skip the card; a guess or a skip turns the next card
2 … Q: Higher or same (13 − r ranks) | Lower or same (r + 1 ranks); A: Higher (12) | Same (1); K: Same (1) | Lower (12); a tie wins an "or same" guess
a wrong guess ends the round and pays nothing; a skip never changes the multiplier
a round shows at most 52 cards (the start card and 51 more); a skip always leaves a card to guess on
a paid round can cash out after its first right guess; a free ($0) round once a card has been turned
a round never pays more than its max win above the stake: a right guess that reaches it cashes the round out at that amount, and so does a right guess on the 52nd card
a payout is rounded down to the wallet's smallest unit (1e-8) once

a round left without a decision for 24 hours is finished by the server: a round that can cash out is cashed out at its value; otherwise the card showing is guessed on its likelier side (hi on a tie of chances) and, if the guess is right, the round is cashed out
/hilo2/fairness.multiplier: after right guesses on cards where n_1 … n_k of the 13 ranks win, the multiplier is 99/100 × Π 13 / n_i, cut to 8 decimals; a stake is paid floor(stake × multiplier)
/hilo2/fairness.return: 99% at any cash-out depth, from any start card, on either side: the 1% edge is charged once, on the first right guess, and every later guess is priced fair (a guess on n ranks wins with chance n/13 and multiplies by 13/n)
/hilo2/fairness.summary: block_i = HMAC_SHA256(key = serverSeed, message = clientSeed:nonce:i); the stream is block_0 ‖ block_1 ‖ … read 4 bytes at a time as big-endian u32s. A u32 of 4294967248 or more (2^32 − 2^32 mod 52) is skipped; otherwise the card is u32 mod 52. One nonce per round: the k-th card turned after the start card (by a guess or a skip) is stream card k − 1. The start card is not from the stream — it is the card you see when you bet (it carries over from your last round, or a free skip before the bet drew it), and any start card is worth the same. Card id 0–51: suit = id / 13 (0 ♠, 1 ♥, 2 ♦, 3 ♣), rank = id mod 13 (0 = A lowest … 12 = K highest). The deck is infinite: every card is drawn independently, 1 in 13 for each rank. The payout: after right guesses on cards where n_1 … n_k of the 13 ranks win, the multiplier is 99/100 × Π 13 / n_i, cut to 8 decimals; a stake is paid floor(stake × multiplier), so the game returns 99% at any cash-out depth, from any start card, on either side: the 1% edge is charged once, on the first right guess, and every later guess is priced fair (a guess on n ranks wins with chance n/13 and multiplies by 13/n). The server seed is committed up front by its SHA-256 hash and revealed when you rotate the pair, so every card of a round is fixed before the bet and can be checked afterwards.
